purpose: Form NDH-4 is used by a public company desirous to be declared as a Nidhi, or by certain existing Nidhis and companies under previous company law, to apply for declaration as a Nidhi or update its status.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Ensure the company fulfils the condition of having not less than two hundred members.
Ensure the company has Net Owned Funds of twenty lakh rupees or more.
Prepare the declaration with regard to fulfilment of fit and proper person criteria by all promoters and directors.
Apply in Form NDH-4 along with the required fee.
checklist: Not less than two hundred members
Net Owned Funds of twenty lakh rupees or more
Declaration of fit and proper person criteria for all promoters and directors
attachments: Declaration with regard to fulfilment of fit and proper person criteria by all the promoters and directors of the company
watch: Non-compliance or rejection of the Form NDH-4 application prevents the company from filing Form No. SH-7 and Form PAS-3, and restricts raising deposits or providing loans.
